en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a woodcut‑style illustration of a narrow cobblestone street in an old European town. Tall plastered and brick buildings with steep, tiled gable roofs line both sides. The street curves under a large arched gate or bridge that connects buildings above the street. Light and shadow are rendered with dense hatch marks and dramatic clouds in the sky. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.
